notablePrerequisites: You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Marvin using Deathbloom Ritualist's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.
